_about: What each program's first fee covers, shown on the quote card and PDF (Daniel, Nov 10, 2026). render.js picks the program from the option name. Lines marked exclusionOnly show only when the option includes exclusion. monthly is the recurring charge from month 4; an option can override it (multi-plan prices, KB Section 8).

signature.name: HomeShield - Signature Pest Control
covers: Your first 3 treatments, over the first 3 months
First two are 2 weeks apart to knock out what you're seeing
Covers and treats 30+ pests, inside and out
Free return visits if pests come back between treatments

critter.name: HomeShield - Critter Control
covers: Inspection, plus full trap and station setup
7 days of daily visits: remove animals, reset bait, clean traps
3 months of coverage: free return visits if they come back

termite.name: Carolina TermiteShield
covers: Liquid soil treatment around the home

catchyClub.name: Catchy Club
covers: Pest, critter and termite protection in one plan
First two treatments 2 weeks apart, then a visit every month

oneTime.name: One Time Service

The full price goes toward any plan if you upgrade
